# Synthetic repair fixture — scenario_type

_provenance: synthetic-test-fixture

Every file under this directory is hand-written synthetic test data for
the WP-09 repair lane. The DAX text and order counts are invented for
tests; they are not customer data and must never be presented as
observed answers. The Microsoft `$schema` URL in `visual.json` is part
of the realistic PBIR shape, not a live reference.
